scope: Second BANK36 mission-description microlot: entries 8-15, including the first proven dynamic HERO-name token record.

control_0015_proof.parser_measure: BANK39 0x393FE0 compares AX with 0x0015, calls 9000:41B8, and adds returned AX to current line width.
control_0015_proof.width_source: BANK39 0x3941B8 counts words from DS:C0DE until FFFF and returns the count.
control_0015_proof.renderer: BANK39 0x3943B8 compares AX with 0x0015 and calls 0x394414; that routine sets F32E=C0DE so the renderer substitutes the RAM string.
control_0015_proof.hero_buffer: BANK3A 0x3A1660 checks up to 8 words at C0DE; BANK3A 0x3A177F stores selected name glyphs to [BX+C0DE]. Thus C0DE is the protagonist name buffer, max 8 glyphs.
control_0015_proof.second_occurrence: Mission entry 38 at 0x3659BA begins 00 15 + とペット, semantically <HERO> and pet; left unchanged in E6 as corroborating evidence.
